name: JW Marriott El Convento Cusco
positioning: Hotel inside a restored 16th-century convent in the heart of Cusco's historic center, near Plaza de Armas, with exhibition halls of ancient Peruvian artifacts, oxygen-enriched rooms and an Andean-inspired spa
best_for: History lovers who want to sleep inside a restored 16th-century convent with on-site archaeological remains
Travelers acclimatizing to Cusco's altitude who value oxygen-enriched rooms
Visitors who want a walkable base near Plaza de Armas in the historic center

facts.text: The hotel is housed inside a restored 16th-century convent in the heart of Cusco's historic center.
The hotel is located near Plaza de Armas.
The hotel has two exhibition halls with ancient Peruvian artifacts.
Killke remains discovered on the property were recovered and preserved within the hotel.
All guest rooms are enriched with oxygen to help guests acclimatize to the elevation.
Luxury suites have king beds and separate living rooms.
Bathrooms have bathtubs, walk-in showers, bathrobes and slippers.
The spa has a Swiss shower and a private indoor pool.
The wellness area includes a sauna, a yoga room, a whirlpool and a steam room.
Guests can take a tour of the convent with the monk on the property and walk to the market with the executive chef.
Qespi Restaurant sits next to a large colonial wall and overlooks the hotel patio.
Weavers in the courtyard give demonstrations.

highlights.text: The hotel is set inside a restored 16th-century convent, with two exhibition halls of ancient Peruvian artifacts.
The reception features a Swarovski light installation shaped like a radiant sun, representing Inti, the Inca Sun God.
Panchita, a baby alpaca, lives in the hotel's patio.
The spa offers Andean-inspired healing treatments, including massages, facials and body scrubs.
Select accommodations have views of the 16th-century San Agustin Convent cloister.

considerations.text: Cusco's altitude can be taxing; the hotel pumps oxygen into rooms to help.
The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
